ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a circle, point C is on the left side of the circle, point D is above the circle, point E is on the right side of the circle, and point F is below the circle; line segments CD, CE, and DF are drawn. The arc DE in the upper right of the circle is labeled 98°, and a 40° angle is also labeled in the figure but does not need to be used when finding ∠C. Reasoning: ∠C is an inscribed angle formed by chords CD and CE, and it intercepts minor arc DE. According to the inscribed angle theorem, the measure of an inscribed angle is equal to half the measure of the intercepted arc, so m∠C = 98° ÷ 2 = 49°.
